subject: Discovery recap — staging access request and demo timing
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@finco.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + request: staging access & next meeting

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Goals: reduce inference latency for in-app recommendations and centralize embeddings for semantic search.
- Constraints: must validate SSO + VPC options, procurement prefers subscription pricing, security will want SOC2 evidence and a short PCA.

Next step: we recommend a 60-minute technical deep-dive (engineers + platform + security) to walk the integration surface, SSO flow, and staging validation. Could you confirm which of these windows work on your side?
- Tue 15 Jun, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Tue 15 Jun, 14:00–15:00 PT
- Thu 17 Jun, 09:00–10:00 PT

Two asks before the meeting if possible:
1) Brief staging access (read-only API key or a temporary service account) so our engineers can sanity-check token exchange and a short perf run.
2) If your security team has a PCA or checklist template, please share so Marissa (cc) can prep the right materials.

I've attached a short demo agenda for the deep dive and a one-pager on our VPC/private deployment options.

[Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 46KB)]

Happy to accommodate other times — let me know what works and I can send a calendar invite.

Best,
Karthik Iyer

karthik@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
